scope.description: Human description of what diff this covers, e.g. 'branch vs master, incl. uncommitted'.

overview.description: Markdown. One paragraph: what the whole change does and why, at the level of a good PR description.

files.description: The complete diff, one entry per changed file in git's own order. Feeds the Tree tab; must cover the entire scope with nothing omitted.

hunks.description: This file's full unified-diff text exactly as git produced it, @@ headers included.

prose.description: Markdown. A few sentences: what the code in this section now does differently, or why it exists.

lang.description: highlight.js language id. Optional; inferred from the file extension when omitted.

hunks.description: diff blocks only. Raw unified-diff text: one or more @@ hunks exactly as git produced them, headers included.

code.description: context blocks only. Verbatim excerpt of existing code that is NOT part of the diff.

startLine.description: context blocks only. Line number of the excerpt's first line in the file.

note.description: context blocks only. Optional markdown pointing out why this excerpt matters here.
